P.name: League of Draven
P.title: Template:Data Draven/League of Draven
P.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|League of Draven|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Draven
|skill        = I
|icon         = League of Draven.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Innate:}} {{ci|Draven}} gains an ''Adoration'' {{tip|stack}} when he catches a {{ai|Spinning Axe|Draven}} or kills a {{tip|minion}}, {{tip|monster}}, or {{tip|turret}}. He loses ''Adoration'' stacks when he {{tip|death|dies}}.
|blurb2       = When '''Draven''' kills an enemy {{tip|champion}}, he consumes all ''Adoration'' stacks to gain {{g|'''bonus''' gold}}.
|description  = {{sbc|Innate:}} When '''Draven''' catches a ''{{ai|Spinning Axe|Draven}}'', kills a non-champion, or destroys a {{tip|turret}}, he gains a {{tip|stack}} of ''Adoration''.
|description2 = When '''Draven''' kills an enemy {{tip|champion}}, he consumes all of his ''Adoration'' stacks and gains {{g|25 + (2{{times}}stacks) '''bonus''' gold}}.
|description3 = '''Draven''' loses 50% of his ''Adoration'' stacks upon {{tip|death}}.
|targeting    = Passive
|affects      = Self
|notes        = 
* Upon reaching 150 ''Adoration'' stacks, and every 100 stacks thereafter, as well as when he cashes at least 150 stacks in, '''Draven''' automatically sends a chat message notifying all players.
* A chat message will display to all players whenever:
** ''League of Draven'' grants over {{g|300 gold}}.
** ''League of Draven'' gets reduced.
* None of the parts of ''League of Draven'' require actually using a {{ai|Spinning Axe|Draven}} for a kill to get ''Adoration'' stacks, as well as to cash ''Adoration'' stacks.
* ''League of Draven'' will trigger upon receiving an assist on an enemy {{tip|execute|executed}} by {{cai|Death from Below|Pyke}}.<ref>[https://www.reddit.com/r/leagueoflegends/comments/8je2sr/comment/dyz51mx/ Reav3 confirming Death from Below synergy is intentional]</ref>
* When receiving {{g|gold}} from an ally {{tip|execute|executing}} a minion through {{nie|Shared Riches}} ({{ii|World Atlas}}, {{ii|Runic Compass}}), '''Draven''' is also awarded a [[File:Strike.png|20px]] ''Strike'' stack.{{bug}}
** A ''Strike'' stack lasts up to 10 seconds or until '''Draven''' fails to catch an ''{{ai|Spinning Axe|Draven|axe}}'' or a nearby {{tip|minion}} dies without him killing it. Upon reacing 6 stacks, '''Draven''' consumes the stacks to gain 2 stacks of ''Adoration''.
** Other sources of gaining ''Strike'' stacks were removed in patch [[V25.06]].
}}

Q.name: Spinning Axe
Q.title: Template:Data Draven/Spinning Axe
Q.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Spinning Axe|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Draven
|skill        = Q
|icon         = Spinning Axe.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Draven|Draven's}} next basic attack will throw an axe, dealing {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}}.
|blurb2       = This axe will ricochet off the target high up into the air. If '''Draven''' catches it, he automatically readies another ''Spinning Axe''. '''Draven''' can have two ''Spinning Axes'' at once.
|description  = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Draven''' starts spinning his axe, empowering his next {{tip|basic attack}} within {{fd|5.8}} seconds to deal {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}}.
|leveling     = {{st|Bonus Physical Damage|{{ap|40 to 60}} {{as|(+ {{ap|75 to 115}}% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
|icon2        = Draven Axe Indicator.png
|description2 = Upon hitting the target, the axe then ricochets off of them to land after roughly 1.4 seconds, with the location being determined by '''Draven's''' {{tt|current movement|See notes}}. If '''Draven''' catches the axe, he gains ''Spinning Axe's'' empowered attack again.
|description3 = '''Draven''' can hold up to two ''Spinning Axes'' at once.
|cooldown     = {{ap|12 to 8}}
|cdstart      = on-cast
|cast time    = none
|cost         = 45
|costtype     = mana
|targeting    = Auto
|spelleffects = basic
|affects      = Self
|damagetype   = Physical
|onhiteffects = Special
|parry        = true
|spellshield  = 
|projectile   = Special
|notes        = 
* The landing location is determined by '''Draven's''' [[movement speed]] and direction at the time ''Spinning Axe'' hits the target. If '''Draven''' is actually moving, it will bounce directly into his path. Otherwise, it will bounce back towards his current location, either landing directly onto him or to his sides.
* ''Spinning Axe'' will place a visual cue on the ground where it will land. This visual cue is visible to both teams, although '''Draven''' himself will see a more prominent marker.
* Axes take roughly 1.35-1.40s to go from target to landing point. This is not affected by attack speed, movement speed or level.
* Recasting ''Spinning Axe'' will refresh the {{tip|buff}} and add another axe if possible.
** There is no limit to how many axes can be juggled at once, just the limit of 2 of them at a time in '''Draven's''' hands.
* '''Draven''' used to be able to catch (steal) an enemy '''Draven''''s axes. This event also prompted a few unique voice lines.  
* ''Spinning Axes'' may optically bypass {{ai|Wind Wall|Yasuo}} and {{ai|Blade Whirl|Samira}} but they will be destroyed upon collision. {{ai|Unbreakable|Braum}} will not prevent the axe from bouncing off when {{ci|Braum}} is the target.
* {{ai|Unbreakable|Braum}} will not prevent the axe from bouncing off when {{ci|Braum}} is not the target.
* The axe will still bounce against parrying effects.
* {{iis|Runaan's Hurricane}} {{nie|Wind's Fury}} does not interact with the effects of the axes.
* If a ''Spinning Axe'' is readied during a basic attack wind-up, the effects will be applied to the fired attack.
* ''Spinning Axe'' attacks deal their total increased damage in a single instance of {{tip|basic damage}}.
* ''Spinning Axe'' may fail to properly bounce back if it hits {{ci|Zaahen}} during or shortly after {{ais|Cultivation of War|Zaahen}} revive.{{bug}}
* The empowered attack will not trigger against {{tip|structures}}.
** The duration will refresh on-attack against them.
* ''Spinning Axe'' has an indicator that appears on the ground for Draven to stand on. Some skins have a unique indicator.

R.name: Whirling Death
R.title: Template:Data Draven/Whirling Death
R.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Whirling Death|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Draven
|skill        = R
|icon         = Whirling Death.png
|blurbicon    = Whirling Death.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Draven}} hurls forth two massive axes that deal {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit. This {{tip|execute|executes}} enemy {{tip|champions}} with {{sti|{{as|health}}}} that would be left within the current number of ''{{ai|League of Draven|Draven}}'' stacks.
|blurb2       = ''Whirling Death'' can be recast while the axes are active, and does so automatically upon hitting an enemy {{tip|champion}} or the edge of the map.
|blurb3       = {{sbc|Recast:}} ''Whirling Death'' slowly reverses direction and homes back to '''Draven''', dealing {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit.
|description  = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Draven''' hurls two massive axes in the target direction that briefly grant {{tip|sight}} of their surroundings and deal {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit. Enemy {{tip|champions}} that are damaged to or while below a {{sti|{{as|health}}}} threshold equal to the number of ''{{ai|League of Draven|Draven|Adoration}}'' stacks are {{tip|execute|executed}}.
|description2 = ''Whirling Death'' can be recast after 1 second while the axes are traveling, and does so automatically after the axes hit an enemy {{tip|champion}} or the edge of the [[Map (League of Legends)|map]].
|leveling     = {{st|Physical Damage|{{ap|200 to 400}} {{as|(+ {{ap|110 to 150}}% '''bonus''' AD)}}|Total Physical Damage|{{ap|200*2 to 400*2}} {{as|(+ {{ap|110*2 to 150*2}}% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
|icon3        = Whirling Death 2.png
|description3 = {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Draven''' forces the axes to reverse direction, slowly coming to a stop before homing back to him, dealing the same damage to enemies hit.
|description4 = ''Whirling Death'' deals {{pp|key=%|type=enemies hit|100*0.95^(x-1);50|x-1 for 15|formula=(100%-5%)^(1 per enemy hit). ''This is capped at 50% damage.''}} damage, resetting upon reversing direction.
|leveling4    = {{st|Minimum Physical Damage|{{ap|200*0.5 to 400*0.5}} {{as|(+ {{ap|110*0.5 to 150*0.5}}% '''bonus''' AD)}}|Minimum Total Damage|{{ap|200*0.5*2 to 400*0.5*2}} {{as|(+ {{ap|110*0.5*2 to 150*0.5*2}}% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
|description5 = ''Enemies can be hit only once per pass.''
|cooldown     = {{ap|100 to 80}}
|cdstart      = on-cast
|cast time    = {{fd|0.5}}
|cost         = 100
|costtype     = mana
|target range = Global
|width        = {{tip|er|icononly = true}} {{tt|320|missile width}}
|speed        = 2000
|targeting    = [[Direction-targeted|Direction]] / [[Auto-targeted|Auto]]
|affects      = Enemies
|damagetype   = Physical
|projectile   = true
|spelleffects = spellaoe
|onhiteffects = 
|spellshield  = Special
|notes   =
* ''Whirling Death's'' projectile has an [[File:Whirling Death Minimap.png|40px|link=]] icon on the mini-map while it is in flight. It can be seen by only '''Draven''' and his allies.
* {{tip|Spell shield}} will block one instance of damage.
{{Effect at cast time end}}
}}
